area.default: whole overlap of the two epochs
area.title: Area

CloudSummary.description: Header-level facts about a point cloud (``pdal info --summary``).
CloudSummary.title: CloudSummary

CommandEvent.description: SSE ``command``: one tool invocation finished; ``index`` is its 1-based place in ``job.json`` ``commands``.
CommandEvent.title: CommandEvent

CommandRecord.description: One external command, as run. ``argv`` is exact; ``pipeline`` is the PDAL JSON fed on stdin.
CommandRecord.title: CommandRecord

CrsRecord.description: Everything a surveyor needs to know about the coordinates of a dataset (CLAUDE.md rule 1).
CrsRecord.title: CrsRecord

CrsRef.description: One CRS (or one component of a compound CRS), as identified.
CrsRef.title: CrsRef

DoneEvent.description: SSE ``done``: the step's own report in ``result``; the job's product kinds and warnings after it.
DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent

ErrorEvent.description: SSE ``error``: a refusal or tool failure; ``stderr`` is the tool's stderr tail when a command failed.
ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent

FileRef.description: A file pinned by digest. ``path`` is relative to the job dir for products, absolute for inputs.
FileRef.title: FileRef

GridSpec.description:
A raster grid snapped to multiples of its resolution, so two epochs at the same res share cells.

``origin_x``/``origin_y`` are the lower-left corner (PDAL writers.gdal's convention); the
GeoTIFF's top-left is ``(origin_x, origin_y + height * res)``.
GridSpec.title: GridSpec

HealthInfo.description: ``GET /health``. ``read_only`` is true unless ``SURVEY_ALLOW_PROCESS`` is set: clients disable writes on it.
HealthInfo.title: HealthInfo

InputRecord.description: An input file, pinned. ``path`` is absolute.
InputRecord.title: InputRecord

JobSidecar.description: ``job.json`` — the API contract and the provenance record of a job.
JobSidecar.title: JobSidecar

OperationCandidate.description: One candidate PROJ offered for a transformation, and why it was or wasn't used.
OperationCandidate.title: OperationCandidate

Product.description: A job output. ``path`` is relative to the job dir.
Product.title: Product

RasterView.description:
``GET /jobs/{id}/web/{kind}`` for a raster: a Web Mercator PNG placed by its lon/lat corners (TL, TR, BR, BL).

``ramp`` names the fixed colour ramp (``terrain``: blue → red over ``range``; ``diverging``: blue (−) → transparent (0)
→ red (+) for a DoD; ``hillshade``: grey, no ``range``). A derived view, never a deliverable.
RasterView.title: RasterView

StartEvent.description: SSE ``start``: the step was accepted and is running.
StartEvent.title: StartEvent

StepEvent.description: SSE ``step``: a (sub-)step started or finished (``run`` reports each of its steps).
StepEvent.title: StepEvent

ToolVersions.description: Versions of the external stack a job ran against (``doctor`` and every sidecar).
ToolVersions.title: ToolVersions

TransformOp.description: The exact coordinate operation a job used (fed verbatim to PDAL's filters.projpipeline).
TransformOp.title: TransformOp

ZoneVolume.description: Volumes between an upper and a lower surface over one polygon (all positive numbers).
ZoneVolume.title: ZoneVolume
